svg.title: Alarm priority matrix and Method 3 placement
svg.desc: Four alarm priorities rendered in normal vision, grayscale, deuteranopia and protanopia (Machado 2009 simulation). Hue collapses under CVD but shape and digit survive. Lower panel compares recoloring the pointer, painting the track, and a separate Method 3 badge.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Alarm Priority Encoding — What Survives When Color Fails
